name: uams-web/brief-arprevention
description: Brief : AR Prevention, a child theme of the Genesis Framework.

scripts.mutate: @php -d pcov.directory=. vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit/ConfigTest.php tests/Unit/CustomizeTest.php tests/Unit/FunctionsTest.php tests/Unit/GutenbergTest.php tests/Unit/HelperFunctionsTest.php tests/Unit/OutputTest.php tests/Unit/PageTemplatesTest.php tests/Unit/ThemeLoadTest.php tests/Unit/WooCommerceNoticeTest.php tests/Unit/WooCommerceOutputTest.php tests/Unit/WooCommerceSetupTest.php --mutate --path=functions.php,lib,config,page-templates

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the test suite (the Unit suite; there is no Integration suite).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.pint: Format the first-party PHP with Pint.
scripts-descriptions.refactor:sweep: Apply Rector's sweep profile; review the diff.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at the level phpstan.neon.dist names.
scripts-descriptions.test:pint: Check the formatting with Pint without changing files.
